scripts.build:local: rm -rf hugo/public && cd hugo && hugo && bun run index
scripts.build: cd hugo && hugo --minify && bun run index
scripts.build:search: bun run build && bun run index
scripts.emulators:test: concurrently "bunx firebase emulators:start --only functions,firestore,auth --project=doula-cooperative-test" "bun run functions:start"
scripts.start: concurrently "bun run emulators:start" "bun run functions:start" "bun run angular:start" "bun run hugo:dev" --names "emulators,functions,angular,hugo"
